passage:
A hospital began using small robots to carry medicine, clean towels, and test samples between rooms. The robots did not talk much. They moved slowly, stopped for people, and waited for elevators.
At first, some patients felt strange seeing robots in the hallway. One old man said he missed talking to nurses. A nurse smiled and said the robots were not replacing her. They were carrying things so she could spend more time with people.
After a few weeks, patients noticed nurses were less rushed. The robots did boring trips. The nurses still gave care.
The hospital learned that technology works best when it gives humans more time to be human.
